description: Panel experiment: every question of the evidence bank, for each evaluation reader, under the question-only and title-only conditions, the 15 excerpt lane sets (the factorial the labels come from) and the whole film with one lane or all lanes. One run, decoded as the reader's profile sets (the thinking readers sample as their developers recommend, seed 0); answers the rules cannot score are left for the fixed judge (pipeline.judge).
name: evidence_bank_v1
